4779-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4779-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1339-2425-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2178-4170-4247-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
2178-4170-4247-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Fain and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fain trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-6720.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

443-1580-2292-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1563-4460-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-4460-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-4460-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

11-1534.manaNeeded: {U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-1534.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-1534.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Twincast targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Twincast to your hand.
Cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Twincast, targeting the copy of Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, creating a copy of Twincast targeting the copy of Twincast.
Repeat step 5.

774-3756-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Izzet Boilerworks's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5078-6766-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

394-4798-5686-7178.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-4798-5686-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

2033-3459-4316-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1115-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1671-5702-6664-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5702-6664-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2232-2792-2921-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-2921-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3062-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Pir.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
3062-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

1879-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

509-1267-3263-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3263-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3263-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

1617-1974-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Quicksilver Gargantuan on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-1974-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Quicksilver Gargantuan to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

1365-4853-5686-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4853-5686-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

101-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Vampire Charmseeker each turn.
101-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Vampire Charmseeker from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2034-3000-3476-4679.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Aura.
2034-3000-3476-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of an Aura you control and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phantatog's first ability by sacrificing the Aura token, giving Phantatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1409-1902-1909-4977.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four Elves.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Wirewood Symbiote.
1409-1902-1909-4977.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Wirewood Symbiote enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing it and Wirewood Symbiote.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Fyndhorn Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, choose not to pair them together.
Repeat from step 2.

1689-1722-2034-2359.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1689-1722-2034-2359.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Season of Growth.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Season of Growth trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

142-1486-1651.description:
Activate Saheeli Rai's -2 loyalty ability, creating a token copy of Magda that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Put the nontoken Magda into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clock of Omens and Magda, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping a Treasure token and Magda, targeting Magda.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Activate Magda's last ability any number of times by sacrificing any number of Treasures.

1987-2556-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1987-2556-3075.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mnemonic Wall and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
